summary: Remote WebSocket controller drives Claude Code with bypassed permissions and arbitrary filesystem access
details: The `agenthub-agent` bin connects to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint (default `wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com`) and dispatches server-delivered messages into a Control handler exposing FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, and FileSearch against arbitrary paths on the host, plus MessageSend which forwards remote text into a Claude Agent SDK session started with `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"`. In that mode Claude's Bash/Write tools execute unattended, so the remote WebSocket peer can read and write arbitrary files and run arbitrary shell commands on the machine running the agent. Control of what runs sits with whoever operates the WebSocket server, not with the local user.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
